seed_ledger.name: E.W. Brown Generating Station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: ONSITE_NO_PIPE: Kentucky Utilities testimony in PSC case 2025-00045 says Brown 12 gets gas from the existing Tennessee Gas or Texas Eastern line that already serves the station, and only new on-site compression is needed. A 2017 study for an 11-mile 30-inch line to Brown (case 2022-00402) was a preliminary estimate, not the current plan. Searched: PSC docket testimony, 2022 study, WEKU news, GOGPT notes. FERC, EIA and air permit pages not found to name a lateral. Utility plant; data center tie is only a news framing.

seed_ledger.name: EdgeConneX New Albany North power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: EXISTING_ROW: the only pipe tied to EdgeConneX New Albany plants is the 24-mile 24-inch Licking County Pipeline for PowerConneX III (P8320, staged earlier as powerconnex-iii-gas-pipeline); no separate source names another pipe. Smaller EdgeConneX plants (120 MW PowerConneX 1) are supplied by National Gas and Oil Cooperative, a local distribution utility. DataCenter tag lead for P8320 only if the plant is the same as PowerConneX III.

seed_ledger.name: Fairfield Energy Center (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Ohio Power Siting Board case 26-160-EL-BGN for the behind-the-meter plant serving the Vantage Millersport campus was reported withdrawn in September 2026; no source names a gas lateral or supplier. Searched: news (Signal Ohio, NBC4, Farm and Dairy), OPSB case, Vantage reports. The nearest lines are Eastern Gas Transmission and Columbia within 3 km. Aristotle South (P8313) ends in Fairfield County but serves New Albany plants, not this one.
